create.name: Tiger Singleton
create.bio:
Tiger Singleton, who also goes by Tigmonk, is a spiritual teacher who lives on Panglao island in the Philippines. For around fifteen years he has been teaching, coaching and talking with people about awakening, and he has lived and taught in more than ten countries along the way. His earlier work went out under the name HeartBased; today he publishes as Tigmonk, through a YouTube channel, a Substack of essays and spoken letters, and regular free livestreams, most of them held on Insight Timer.

His style is conversational and unadorned, closer to a frank talk among friends than a formal lesson. He is wary of spiritual jargon and arguments about doctrine, and keeps returning to a few plain moves: becoming still, looking honestly at what is actually true in this moment, and letting that truth have room rather than pushing it away. Recurring themes include fear, the ego's habit of seeking, self-forgiveness and the relief of seeing that nothing essential is missing. On Insight Timer he has published multi-day courses such as 30 Days of Conscious Living and Spirituality 101. He also hosts an online community for regular listeners and takes on a small number of one-to-one mentoring clients, who apply first through a short exchange of emails.

courses.title: 1 on 1 Mentoring with Tiger
courses.description: Private mentoring with a plan shaped around each client. You start by answering three short questions by email, and if it looks like a good fit he invites you to a conversation about working together.

courses.title: Tigmonk Community
courses.description: An online community for regular listeners, with live teaching and question sessions, small practice groups and course material. Entry details are sent by email on request.

courses.title: 30 Days Of Conscious Living
courses.description: A month-long Insight Timer course with a short talk for each day, built around noticing the mind's stories and living with more openness and humour.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Spirituality 101: Grounded, Loving, Playful
courses.description: A five-day Insight Timer course on the practical basics of a spiritual life, aimed at becoming steadier, kinder and lighter in everyday situations.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Tiger Singleton on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer page has guided meditations, reflective talks and recordings of his livestreams, all free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Free LiveStreams with Tiger
free_resources.description: Live teaching and question sessions held several times a month, mostly on Insight Timer, with times suited to the US, Europe and Australia. Sign up by email to get the schedule.

free_resources.title: Tigmonk on Substack
free_resources.description: His Substack carries essays, audio letters and podcast episodes, including a five-part Spirituality 101 series. Most posts are free, with optional paid support.
